## Summary

I've successfully fixed the computed field bug in the sechirut app. The issue was that the formula `תקרה נמוכה = min(תקרה לפי 3 חודשים, תקרה לפי שליש)` was generating Dart code that referenced stored field values (`_v[10]` and `_v[11]`) which are empty on new record creation.

**The Fix:**
Modified `machtzev/generator/render-ds.mjs` to expand formula references inline when they appear inside `min()` or `max()` functions. This ensures formulas compute correctly from base fields even on new record creation, without affecting other apps that use formulas differently.
